subject: Clarify SOW coupling and implementation checklist — Orbital AI order form
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitalai.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@orbitalai.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Questions on SOW coupling and implementation timeline

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We received the draft Order Form and SOW (attached) and have two quick asks before we route to procurement:

1) The SOW references an MSA coupling clause (Exhibit A, section 3.2) that seemed to tie ramp milestones to billing start dates. Can you confirm whether billing will begin on first production token or on the agreed cutover date?

2) We need a short implementation checklist (dependencies, expected cutover week, required contacts) to include with our internal kickoff so that our infra team can validate network/peering.

Can you send the checklist and confirm the billing alignment by EOD Tuesday? Weve got a procurement review scheduled for next Friday.

Attachments: Orbital_Initial_SOW_v3.docx (proposal)

Thanks,
Samantha Li
Head of Platform Partnerships
Orbital AI

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitalai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Questions on SOW coupling and implementation timeline

Samantha,

Appreciate the clear asks. Short answers up front: billing is expected to align to the cutover date in the SOW (not first production token), but Legal wants to formalize the wording in Exhibit A so theres no ambiguity. Im attaching a concise implementation checklist for your infra team — it covers network endpoints, required credentials, expected lead times for peering, and a suggested 4-week cutover window.

I'll loop in Laura (Legal) to confirm the exact invoice trigger language and Karthik (Account Exec) to coordinate the procurement timeline.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura to provide a one-paragraph redline for Exhibit A (billing trigger) by Monday.
- We deliver a finalized checklist and a DocuSign link by Wednesday so you can present to procurement on Friday.

Attachment: RWI_implementation-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:09:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Questions on SOW coupling and implementation timeline

Laura,

Fwd'ing Samantha's note and the draft SOW. Legal ask: can you confirm the language we should use to make billing start = "cutover date" and not "first production token"? Procurement is time-boxed and we want to avoid back-and-forth.

Specific asks:
- One-paragraph redline for Exhibit A (billing trigger).
- Confirm whether Exhibit A also needs a paragraph clarifying invoice timing for ramp/credits.
- Any other contract exposure you see in the SOW's implementation milestones (section 4.1-4.4).

Karthik, FYI, theyre aiming to present to procurement on Friday.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Dec 2026 10:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Questions on SOW coupling and implementation timeline

Priyom, Karthik,

Reviewed the SOW and Exhibit A. Key redlines I recommend (summary):

1) Billing trigger language (Exhibit A, section 3.2) 
-- Replace vague wording with: "Billing start date shall be the mutually agreed production cutover date as evidenced by both parties' written acceptance of the implementation checklist and completion of production smoke tests."

2) Ramp credits / prorate clarification
-- Add a single sentence to the invoice timing clause: "If partial production is accepted prior to full cutover, usage during the ramp period will be eligible for prorated credits as defined in Exhibit B."

3) Milestone acceptance criteria (SOW sections 4.1-4.4)
-- Tighten acceptance definition to require: (a) documented test results, (b) confirmation from customer's infra lead, and (c) no outstanding critical issues for >24 hours. This avoids ambiguous "accepted" language.

4) Security attestation checkbox
-- Add a short line under implementation dependencies that the customer will complete network allowlist confirmation 5 business days before cutover.

I attached a PDF with inline suggested redlines for the SOW and a clean one-paragraph replacement for Exhibit A. We should expect the customer to push back on credits language; Karthik, happy to discuss trade-offs (credit caps, lookback windows) in a quick call.

Attachment: RWI_legal_redlines_20261221.pdf

If the team is comfortable, I can prepare a tracked-change doc for Samantha and a short email summarizing the final agreed wording.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Li <samantha.li@orbitalai.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 28 Dec 2026 17:22:00 -0800
Subject: Final SOW wording and checklist for procurement review (Orbital AI)

Samantha,

Thanks for your patience — attaching the implementation checklist we discussed and a one-paragraph replacement for Exhibit A that Laura drafted. Summary of what changed: 

- Billing start = mutually agreed production cutover date, evidenced by acceptance criteria and completed smoke tests (language from Laura).
- Ramp/proration: usage during partial production can be credited per Exhibit B (we added a cap and a 30-day lookback window; details in the attached redline).
- Acceptance criteria tightened to include documented test results and infra lead sign-off.
- Security dependency: customer to confirm allowlist 5 business days prior to cutover.

Attachments: RWI_implementation-checklist.xlsx, RWI_legal_redlines_20261221.pdf

If this looks good, I will:
1) Upload the redlined SOW to DocuSign and send the envelope link (we aim to have this signed ahead of your procurement meeting).
2) Schedule a 30-minute cutover planning call with your infra lead for early January.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-12345
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8712

Can you confirm approval to proceed with DocuSign by Wednesday?

Best,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
